report_title: Final commitment: exact affine elimination and redundancy removal

shape.source: 13873 vars / 3202 rows / 79655 constraint nonzeros / 69 integers / 2601323 B MPS

edit_summary: Eliminate 24 continuous dmd_i columns via dmd_i = spp_i - delta_i (delta_i = sum BAL_ij RHS - sum BAL_ki RHS, all 24 nonzero, both signs); delete 24 DEMD equalities, 24 dominated thresholds, 15 exact duplicate rows and INx; rewrite 21 retained rows (10 THR2 plus cuts c2819..c2829) by moving coefficient a from dmd_i to spp_i and shifting the RHS to r + a*delta_i.
claims: 4 claims = (integer, LP) x (forward, reverse); objective 'Equal' in all; projection is the identity on all 13,849 retained coordinates in every claim; inverse pairing [1,0,3,2]
Obligations per claim 45355 / 45419 / 45286 / 45350 = 181,410 total, 2,499,882 work units, no branches
Forward claims: 24 alias Eq derivations (94-term Lin) + 21 rewritten-row corrections (2-term Lin) + 24 dominated-threshold slack Lin steps
Reverse claims: 24 93-term Lin steps recover the deleted DEMD rows, 1 47-term Lin recovers INx, 24 reconstruction identities map dmd_i to spp_i + 129 at coordinates 13849..13872
24 eliminated lower bounds are proved from retained spp lower bounds (supply_lower - delta_i >= 0) and 483 unit-bounded x columns stay continuous
proof_encoding: RPA 1: claims plus 4 blocks; proof.rpa 5,160,620 B -> proof.rpx 3,604,378 B; steps per block 69 (forward) / 73 (reverse)
Only 284 Lin steps in total: 24x94-term and 24x93-term per direction pair, 42x2-term rewritten rows, 48x1-term bounds, 2x47-term INx
Bookkeeping dominates: Return maps 2,117,982 B and check lists 2,144,548 B versus 210,766 B of steps; claims array 687,107 B
checks lists hold 110,934 literal 'Exact' entries plus 70,476 Local refs, ordered bounds-rows-objective-projection-inverse
request.json 2,459,969 B: 4 x 13,849 projection pairs, 55,396/55,396 of them [i,i]
agent_manual_work: Two independent exact MPS parsers (dict-based Fraction and fixed-field Decimal) agreeing on every row, coefficient, RHS, bound and the 69 integer markers
Hand-built the 24 elimination certificates by exact sparse rational addition over SUPP/DEMD/FLO/BAL rows (94-row combination each) plus the delta table, then re-derived them for the audit
Hand-wrote the substitution twice: substitute_demand_row (coefficient moves to spp, RHS += a*delta) and an independent projection implementation to audit the written artifact

Invented the audit.json schema: removed_variables[].reconstruct, aggregate_balance_certificates[].original_equality_combination, removed_rows{dominated_thresholds,duplicates}, degree_certificate, modified_retained_rows before/after
Hand queries over all 47,967 lines: per-column row incidence for each dmd, exact row-signature duplicate groups, positive-proportional scan, union-find incidence connectivity
